3. The Administrative Tribunal on 14-7-2002 took up the case for hearing on the issues of maintainability and limitation. After hearing the party and on perusal of the pleading the Tribunal dismissed the suit as not maintainable for want of final order on the appeal made by the petitioner and as banned by limitation since the limitation provided by section-4(2) of the Administrative Tribunal Act, 1980, for filing of case being 6 months from the date of final order and the instant case was filed on 14-2-2002 and thus filed beyond six(6) months from the date of issuance of the legal notice being 10-7-2001. 

 4. Being aggrieved the petitioner filed the appeal before the Administrative Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka, in appeal No. 64 of 2002 under Section-6 of the Appellate Tribunal Act, 1980 on 05-10-2002 and the appeal was heard and disposed of by the impugned judgment and order dated 19-6-2008 dismissing the appeal holding the case, as filed, to be barred by limitation as per section-4(2) of the Act, 1980 observing further that the petitioner did not prefer any appeal against the points raised in accordance with law. 

 7. We have considered the submissions of the learned Advocate, who however found it difficult to overcome the finding of the Appellate Tribunal on the issue of limitation inasmuch as it has been asserted by the petitioner in the application filed before the Administrative Tribunal that lastly he caused issuance of the legal notice on 10-7-2001 demanding justice as to his claims mentioned hereinabove namely, (1) addition of the period of his service in Hossen Industries Ltd., (2) granting of selection grade pay scale, (3) promotions and release of his pay and allowances stopped.
